title: Treat Your Honeypot Analysis Like Code: Git, Pull Requests and a Human Gate for AI [Guest Diary], (Wed, Nov 18th)
description: This analysis discusses a method for managing honeypot activity reports using version control (Git) and AI-assisted drafting with mandatory human review. The approach ensures reproducibility, public safety by preventing accidental disclosure of sensitive information, and accountability for AI-generated content. The workflow uses a separate AI identity for proposing changes, a pull request review process that requires human approval, secret scanning, and placeholders for sensitive data. This method aims to improve trustworthiness and safety in publishing honeypot analyses.
